_comment: r34 Phase 1: LOCKED numeric experiment config for the M2 simulator. Physics constants + PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTORs. Loaded by the M2 env; does NOT affect the action-spec config hash. See primary_design_parameter_register.md.

channel.source: 3GPP TR 38.901 / ETSI TR 138 901 V18.1.0 (2026-02), Release 18, Indoor Factory InF-SH
channel.pathloss_nlos_infsh_db_rule: PL_NLOS_InF-SH = max(PL_LOS, 32.4 + 23.0*log10(d3D) + 20.0*log10(fc_GHz))  [ETSI TR 138 901 V18.1.0 Table 7.4.1-1, InF-SH]
channel.pathloss_nlos_infdh_db_rule: DISTINCT (InF-DH, not used here): max(PL_LOS, 33.63 + 21.9*log10(d3D) + 20.0*log10(fc_GHz)), SF=4.0
channel.los_probability_rule: InF high-BS: P_LOS = exp(-d2D / k_subce), k_subce = (-d_clutter/ln(1-r)) * (hBS-hUT)/(hc-hUT)  [ETSI TR 138 901 V18.1.0 7.4.2 / Table 7.2-4]
channel.clutter_height_hc_m_class: PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR (NOT the 3GPP calibration value); sensitivity includes the InF-SH sparse-clutter calibration hc=2 m
channel._class: large-scale InF-SH pathloss + LOS-probability form = SOURCED (ETSI TR 138 901 V18.1.0 clauses); clutter height hc=5 m + spatial Rician/Rayleigh beam-level abstraction + K_R = PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR / DESIGN_MODEL (NOT a full TR 38.901 clustered channel; hc=2 m is the sourced calibration sensitivity)

traffic.arrival_process: independent Bernoulli per device per slot
traffic._class: PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR; mobile deadline order (2 slots = 2 ms with tau=1ms) anchored by TS 22.261 ms-order factory requirements (our preregistered mapping, not a standard-mandated exact mapping)

targets._class: rho_mobile SOURCED order (TS 22.261 URLLC 1e-5); others PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR

beam_csi.beam_observation: stale CSI delayed by d_CSI slots; learned/predictive selection; perfect-current-CSI Max-Gain = oracle

mobility._class: trajectory family PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR; speed envelope literature-anchored (AMR/AGV ~2 m/s)

lppo._class: all PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR; numerical tuning is M2/E1
